answer: SELECT AVG(u.UpVotes) AS avg_upvotes, AVG(u.Age) AS avg_age FROM users u WHERE u.Id IN (SELECT OwnerUserId FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY OwnerUserId HAVING COUNT(Id) > 10);
